facts.text: The user asked for a fictitious small video game company with about 50 employees.
The user asked for the fictitious company to be named Pixel Paradise.
The user asked for Pixel Paradise to have a top selling game called Escape the Island.
The user asked what regulations Pixel Paradise must adhere to.
The user stated that Pixel Paradise offices in Los Angeles include a game development studio, a sound recording studio, a cutting-edge testing lab, and business offices.
The user stated that all 50 employees at Pixel Paradise can work remotely.
